title: SPQR: A History of Ancient Rome
author: Mary Beard
summary: Mary Beard surveys Rome from its legendary beginnings to the early third century CE, questioning familiar stories and looking at how ordinary Romans, slaves and outsiders fit into the empire's rise.
readIf: you want a thoughtful, skeptical one-volume account of Rome rather than a list of emperors.
skipIf: you want a battle-focused narrative or a strict year-by-year chronology.
